title: AI Branches
subtitle: Build with today’s AI capabilities
description: Move from concepts to applications. Work across text, vision, speech, and multimodal systems while learning where APIs, open models, structured outputs, and human review fit.

Choose between prompting, retrieval, and fine-tuning
